curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What happens when an aging warlord divides his kingdom between his three sons?
curatedMovie.description: In sixteenth-century Japan, an aging warlord divides his kingdom between his three sons in a singular historical epic.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, thoughtful historical tragedy built for immersive solo viewing, balancing deliberate pacing with devastating drama.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Its 160-minute blend of action, drama, and history offers an immersive, thoughtful choice for viewers drawn to ambitious historical storytelling.
